questions.q: To whom does the elder write 3 John?
questions.evidence: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth

questions.q: What fault does the elder find in Diotrephes?
questions.evidence: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say

questions.q: What gives the elder no greater joy?
options: Hearing his children walk in truth
questions.evidence: I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children walking in truth
